alt: Side-by-side product photo of the HONOR Robot Phone: left panel shows the silver handset back with its mechanical gimbal arm module; right panel shows a close-up of the robotic camera arm fully extended with the square camera module dangling on the articulated titanium arm
story: HONOR launched the Robot Phone on August 12, 2026 — a $1,485 smartphone with a 4-degree-of-freedom titanium robotic arm camera that extends above the screen, tracks subjects, responds to 10 gestures, and dances to music — co-engineered with cinema camera company ARRI, because apparently normal cameras weren't cinematically ambitious enough.
why_funny: The design brief was apparently 'what if the camera was alive?' and the answer was a phone that can nod its tiny titanium head in agreement with you.
